notes.title: Emberbane's Kickstarter Campaign: A New Chapter Begins!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

We are thrilled to announce that the moment we’ve all been eagerly awaiting is finally here. The Kickstarter campaign for Emberbane is now live, marking a new chapter in our journey!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42684149/6c550b182572d81841cf1a09845df5d9733447ba.jpg[/img]

Over the past months, we've been hard at work, meticulously crafting a unique gaming experience that blends engaging narrative, captivating environments, and dynamic elemental combat. Emberbane is more than just a game; it's a labor of love, a testament to our passion for the Metroidvania genre, and a homage to the stories and games that have inspired us.

Today, we share with you a glimpse of this world we’ve been breathing life into. Accompanying the launch of our Kickstarter campaign is a brand-new trailer that showcases the gameplay, story, and universe of Emberbane. It gives you a taste of the adventure that awaits and the mysteries you, as Ophelia of Elsinore, will unravel.


Check out our Kickstarter Campaign and new trailer here:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/teamhamlet/emberbane


Your supports will be invaluable, and you will have opportunity to shape the Emberbane!

Let the adventure begin!

Best,
Yunus

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2023/05/emberbane-is-an-epic-pixel-art-metroidvania-inspired-by-avatar-the-last-airbender

notes.title: A Hacker Attack to Our Servers
notes.content:
Hey there! 

We are deeply sorry to share these news, but our servers got attacked by hackers today. For a limited time, they have changed the store page of our game and changed the assets in it. 

But more importantly, they have changed the release date of our game to tomorrow. We have contacted Steam Support to fix it.

In mean time, hackers also disbanded our Discord channel, so we have lost contact within our community and testers. Sadly, it will take some time to recover from that.

Release date is this summer for Early Access as planned. No matter what you see on the store page right now, it is trivial.

In mean time, you can join our new Discord channel to grow our community again. Sorry again for this mess, we are deeply sorry. Hopefully, it will not interrupt development of our game. We are going to release a Steam Demo, planned to be set on February 20.

Our Discord Channel: https://discord.gg/qcG75QGk7z

Our Instagram Page: https://www.instagram.com/hamlet_games/

Our Twitter Page: https://twitter.com/hamlet_games

Our upcoming Kickstarter Campaign Page: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/teamhamlet/emberbane
Thanks!
Yunus

notes.title: Emberbane is a pixel action-platformer inspired by Avatar the Last Airbender
notes.content:
The popular Avatar the Last Airbender series continues to have an influence on game developers, with Emberbane being announced as an upcoming pixel action-platformer with combat revolving around a mixture of four elements with unique abilities.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2022/08/emberbane-is-a-pixel-action-platformer-inspired-by-avatar-the-last-airbender
